decision.reason: [ev-dd15d8ccb61e] is one changelog title under Enhancements, "Use runtime.Object in routerTransform", with only a link to PR #10523. It doesn't name an operator-facing subject, a before/after state, which configurations or providers are affected, or what happens if nothing is done. It doesn't even say the change has no visible effect for operators. To write the assertion we would need the PR description or diff, or other release text that says whether any configuration or behaviour changed.
